materials.cover_letter:
I build systems that make technical workflows faster and more reliable by eliminating friction between people, tools, and content. That’s the job I’ve been doing for years.

At Redwood, I built FlareGuard, a validation workflow that cut escalations by 70–80% and automated documentation pipelines end-to-end. I redesigned a 200-article help portal with role-aware navigation and solved a years-long customer complaint with a new PDF pipeline. At Attentive, I owned product docs for the SMS/MMS platform and partnered directly with Support and Engineering to align product changes with customer needs. I understand the loop between implementation, feedback, and shipping—because I’ve lived it.

Your Forward Deployed Engineer role requires someone who can go into customer environments, do technical discovery, debug setups, and capture product gaps. I have done exactly that—across codebases, help systems, and cross-functional teams. I can help your customers get Make Local working and turn their blockers into actionable feedback for your Product and Engineering teams. I’d like to do that for Figma.
